titles.title: Abandoned Mine Lands Cleanup and Taxpayer Fairness Act

To provide that production of all locatable minerals from mining claims located under the general mining laws, or mineral concentrates or products derived from locatable minerals from such mining claims, shall be subject to a royalty of 12.5 percent of the gross income from mining, and for other purposes.
